items.title: BofA cuts PG&E to Neutral as California wildfire reforms fall short
items.summary: Investing.com -- Bank of America downgraded PG&E Corp. to Neutral from Buy on Tuesday, saying California's latest wildfire legislation failed to provide the durable liability and financing framework needed to support the utility's ambitious investment plans.

items.title: California Wildfire Legislation Postponed, Utility Stocks Bounce
items.summary: A deal between Gov. Gavin Newsom and state legislators fell apart at the last minute. PG&E and Edison International recovered on the news, after plummeting on Monday.

items.title: PG&E Stock, Edison International Rise as California Lawmakers Kill Wildfire Bill
items.summary: PG&E stock rises after a report that California lawmakers kill a key wildfire bill that didn’t include liability protection for utilities.

items.title: Chevron, Exxon and Other Oil Stocks Jump as Two Huge Energy Stories Collide
items.summary: Iran and Venezuela just handed energy investors two completely opposite catalysts at the same time, and Chevron, Exxon, and Halliburton are reacting in real time as traders try to figure out which story actually matters for their portfolios.
